title: Native accessibility traversal and private-session probe

claims.text: observe walks the AT-SPI desktop within deadline and node limits, records raw observations, and returns nodes, complete, truncated and owner_ref.
_probe starts Xvfb, dbus, browser and worker processes in a private session and reports no_document, incomplete_tree, missing_control and stale_ready checks.
_native_worker polls observe until the owned document is ready or the tree quiets, then emits the canonical observation, raw and diagnostic triple.

decision.rule: Change here when native traversal, session setup or required-control checks need to change.
decision.failure: Owned browser documents are missed, truncated trees pass as complete, or probe sessions leak.

questions.q: Where does observe traverse the AT-SPI desktop and hash raw observations?
Where should I change the private-session startup and required-control checks?
Where can I debug why the native probe reports no_document or missing_control?
